story.titleZh: 周末积极开局，寻找最佳平衡点
story.summaryZh: 车手表示周末开局积极，在低速和高速弯角之间寻找最佳平衡点，尽管赛道上的凹凸不平增加了难度，但FP1和FP2期间的工作进展顺利。

story.originalTitle: 🗣️: "It’s been a positive start to the weekend. This track is never easy when it comes to finding the right compromise between the low and high-s...
story.summaryEn:
🗣️: "It’s been a positive start to the weekend. This track is never easy when it comes to finding the right compromise between the low and high-speed corners.
"The bumps make it even more difficult, so you’re trying to find a good balance in the car and get into a rhythm. 
"That’s what we’ve been working on between FP1 and FP2. There’s still a bit more work to do to fine-tune that balance, but it wasn’t a bad day at all.”
#F1 || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailZh:
🗣️: "这个周末的开局很积极。这条赛道在寻找低速和高速弯角之间的正确妥协时从来都不容易。
"颠簸使得情况更加困难，所以你试图在车内找到良好的平衡并进入节奏。
"这就是我们在FP1和FP2之间一直在努力的事情。为了微调这个平衡，我们还有更多的工作要做，但总的来说，这并不是一个糟糕的一天。”
#F1 || #USGP 🇺🇸
detailEn:
🗣️: "It’s been a positive start to the weekend. This track is never easy when it comes to finding the right compromise between the low and high-speed corners.
"The bumps make it even more difficult, so you’re trying to find a good balance in the car and get into a rhythm. 
"That’s what we’ve been working on between FP1 and FP2. There’s still a bit more work to do to fine-tune that balance, but it wasn’t a bad day at all.”
#F1 || #USGP 🇺🇸
